description: Cancel one booking under the provider's cancellation policy and email the client. Returns a preview first and only acts when confirm=true. No money moves through the assistant. Any refund or fee is applied by Appty, the same as the dashboard. The client pays anything still due on Appty.

confirm.description: Set true only after the caller has seen a preview and wants it done. Anything else, including the string "true", is a preview and changes nothing.

name: cancel_booking
title: Cancel a booking
